about: Codex (codex exec, read-only, everything inline: series rules, titles, reviewed raw chapters, ticked cuts, OCR of her notes, full transcript) reviewed the 13 chapter lists and titles after the inline Claude review (review_15-27.md). Every finding was checked against the transcript; 'take' = applied to edited_predicted/timestamps_raw.txt (possibly reworded), 'reject' = not applied, with the reason. Reports: <folder>/edited_predicted/review_codex.md.

17.title: kept (Codex agrees)
17.lecturer_mistakes: Codex: (1) 1:43:33-1:44:43 the Borel-homomorphism argument proves 'no countable Borel colouring', not BM: TRUE, correction note proposed. (2) 0:38:36 'because there are no cycles' should be 'no odd cycles': a verbal slip, the written statement at 32:50 says odd cycles; no note. (3) 1:16:41-1:17:24 'a BM colouring needs continuum many colours' overreaches: REJECTED, a BM colouring is continuous on a comeager G_δ, its image there is analytic, and if that image were countable one colour class would be nonmeager and her proof applies; so the image is uncountable analytic, hence of size continuum
